# Stratexim

> Stratexim is a custom textile design and manufacturing company based in
> Ostrava, Czech Republic (EU). It takes textile products from an idea or a
> technical drawing all the way to serial production of tens of thousands of
> pieces — covering design, material selection, manufacturing, quality control
> and logistics in one place. The team comes from the defence textile sector
> and now serves defence, industry, medical, fashion and home/hotel markets.
> Brand slogan: Precision · Durability · Innovation.

## Key facts

- Legal entity: Bonimport Global s.r.o. (Company ID/IČO 23035650, VAT CZ23035650)
- Location: Čujkovova 1714/21, 700 30 Ostrava, Czech Republic
- Founded: 2025 (founders with 20+ years combined textile experience)
- Founders: Tomáš Boniatti (CEO — sales, finance, operations), Myron Mahurskyj (CTO — product design, development, serial production)
- Contact: info@stratexim.com, +420 776 655 106
- Languages: English, Czech, German
- Manufacturing: made in the European Union; volumes from prototype to tens of thousands of pieces

## What Stratexim does (six segments)

- Defence & Mil-Pol: ballistic vests, plate carriers, CBRN suits, uniforms, magazine pouches, backpacks, sleeping bags — for army, police, firefighters and rescue units.
- Industry: bags & cases, covers & tarps, workwear, automotive textiles, protective and cut-resistant gloves, hearing protection.
- Medical & Protection: mattress protectors, medical staff clothing, waterproof sheets, hospital bedding, respirators & face masks, towels.
- Fashion & Merch: own clothing lines, branded merch, promotional and corporate wear.
- Home & Hotels: bedding, bath mats, bathrobes, towels — durable enough for hotel use.
- Special-Use Fabrics: cut-resistant, stab-proof, ballistic, flame-resistant, membrane, antifungal, hydrophobic, antibacterial, antistatic and UV-resistant fabrics, supplied by the metre or built into products.
